name: User Locked Out
description: Notifies a user that their account has been locked out due to too many failed sign in attempts.
subject: Your ${PRODUCT_NAME} account has been locked
body:
Account locked

Dear ${user.name},

#if (${attempts.size()} > 0)

Your ${PRODUCT_NAME} account has been locked because of the following failed sign-in attempts:

#foreach ($attempt in ${attempts})
${attempt.count} attempts from ${attempt.location}
#end #{else}

Your ${PRODUCT_NAME} account has been locked because of multiple failed sign-in attempts.

#end
Locked on ${timeLocked}. Remains locked until ${timeLockedUntil}.
#if (${passwordResetUrl})

If you have forgotten your password, reset it at ${passwordResetUrl}.

#end

If you believe someone else was trying to use your account, contact your administrator immediately.

Thank you,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
